dpi.label: DPI stages
dpi.description: The stages the DPI± buttons cycle through, from 50 to 26,000 in steps of 10.

polling.label: Polling rate
polling.description: Rates above 1 kHz need the high-speed dongle.

motionSync.label: Motion Sync
motionSync.description: Syncs sensor reads with polling. Smoother movement, about 1 ms more delay.

linear.label: Linear correction
linear.description: Angle snapping: straightens strokes that should be straight.

ripple.label: Ripple control
ripple.description: Smooths sensor noise at high DPI.

glass.label: Glass mode
glass.description: Improves tracking on glass. Turn it off on regular mouse pads.

debounce.label: Press debounce
debounce.description: How long the mouse waits to confirm a click.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: Scrolling uses a function code that hasn't been decoded yet, so it can't be changed.
